before.description:
Discover the fascinating underwater world of the Red Sea on a glass-bottom boat in Hurghada – without getting wet. Through the large panoramic windows, you can observe colorful coral reefs, clownfish, surgeonfish, and many other sea creatures from the comfort of your seat.

After the boat ride, we dock at a quiet snorkeling spot where you have the opportunity to experience the underwater world firsthand through guided snorkeling. Snorkeling time is approximately 30 minutes and is also excellent for beginners.

Life vest, snorkel, and mask are already included in the price. Our German-speaking staff ensures you feel safe and comfortable at all times.

Why this excursion is so popular:

The glass-bottom boat excursion combines two experiences in one tour: the relaxed observation of the underwater world from the boat and active snorkeling in the Red Sea. The tour is especially popular with families with children, non-swimmers, and guests who want to discover the coral reefs of Hurghada in a safe and comfortable way.

before.description:
Imagine: soft white sand under your feet, the sea shimmering in every shade of turquoise, the sun glistening on the water surface - welcome to Mahmya Island, one of the most beautiful spots in the Red Sea.

The Mahmya Island trip in Hurghada is far more than a regular snorkeling excursion. It is a journey to a protected natural paradise, rightfully known as the "Maldives of Egypt."

Here you will find spectacular coral reefs, crystal-clear water, and an underwater world full of color and life. Away from the hustle and bustle, you can experience tranquility, luxury, and nature in perfect harmony.

This trip is ideal for guests looking for a high-quality island and snorkeling excursion from Hurghada with comfort, nature, and relaxation.

Why this trip ranks among the best in Hurghada

✔ One of the most beautiful snorkeling spots in the Red Sea
✔ Protected national park - unspoiled nature
✔ Dream beach with fine, white sand
✔ High-quality boat tour with professional crew
✔ Lunch at a beach restaurant with sea view
✔ Perfect for couples, families & connoisseurs

itinerary.content: Am frühen Morgen werden Sie directly from your hotel abgeholt und zum Hafen gebracht. Dort begrüßt Sie die freundliche Crew an Bord Ihres komfortablen Bootes.

itinerary.title: Snorkeling Trip
itinerary.content: After receiving your snorkeling equipment and a short briefing beginnt die Fahrt über das tiefblaue Rote Meer. Schon bald erreichen Sie die ersten Schnorchelplätze mit bunten Fischen, Korallenformationen und mit etwas Glück sogar Meeresschildkröten oder Delfine.

itinerary.title: Mahmya Island & Lunch
itinerary.content: After arriving at Mahmya Island, enjoy the dreamlike scenery und ein frisch zubereitetes Mittagsbuffet in einem Restaurant direkt am Meer. Der restliche Day gehört ganz Ihnen: Entspannen, Schwimmen, die Island erkunden oder die Ruhe und Sonne genießen.

itinerary.title: Return to Hotel
itinerary.content: Am Nachmittag kehren Sie entspannt zum Hafen zurück und werden zu Ihrem Hotel gebracht.

before.description:
Discover one of the most impressive cultural journeys in Egypt with Hurghada Reiseplaner. This 2-day Luxor trip with hot air balloon ride combines history, adventure, and comfort with an overnight hotel stay in Luxor.

The tour includes a hot air balloon ride at sunrise, the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, the Colossi of Memnon, Karnak Temple, hotel overnight stay, dinner, breakfast, admission tickets, transfers, and a German-speaking Egyptologist.

Ideal for guests who want to experience the highlights of the ancient city of Luxor in a relaxed and intensive way, rather than just a brief visit.

itinerary.title: 17:00 Uhr – Abholung vom Hotel
itinerary.content: Start von Hurghada, Marsa Alam oder El Quseir in einem air-conditioned private vehicle. Nach approx. 3,5 Stunden erreichen Sie Luxor.

itinerary.title: Arrival, Dinner & Check-in
itinerary.content: Sie genießen ein entspanntes Dinner und beziehen Ihr ausgewähltes Hotel, bevor die Night zur Vorbereitung auf das morgendliche Abenteuer ruht.

itinerary.title: Sunrise over Luxor – Hot Air Balloon Ride
itinerary.content: Gegen 4:00 Uhr startet Ihre Heißluftballonfahrt. Während die Sonne langsam das Niltal färbt, schweben Sie über Tempel, Felder und den Westjordan des antiken Theben. Ein Moment, der Ihrem Reisealbum Glanz verleiht.

itinerary.title: Valley of the Kings – Three Tombs
itinerary.content: Erkunden Sie die Gräber der Pharaonen, deren Wandmalereien seit Jahrtausenden leuchten.

itinerary.title: Temple of Hatshepsut
itinerary.content: Ein Tempel wie aus einem Fels geschnitten. Würde, Geschichte, klare Linien.

itinerary.title: Colossi of Memnon – Photo Stop
itinerary.content: Die monumentalen Wächterfiguren des Amenophis III. erwarten Sie bereits.

itinerary.title: Lunch on the Nile
itinerary.content: Ein reichhaltiges ägyptisches Menü bietet Stärkung für den weiteren Tag.

itinerary.title: Karnak Temple
itinerary.content: Zum Finale Ihres Ausflugs entdecken Sie den größten Tempelkomplex Ägyptens. Tempel, gewaltige Säulen, Jahrtausende Kultur – ein würdiger Abschluss.

itinerary.title: Return to Hurghada
itinerary.content: Arrival at your hotel around 8:00 PM.

faqs.answer: Bequeme Kleidung, feste Schuhe und im Winter eine leichte Jacke. Für den Ballonstart am Morgen kann es kühl sein.

before.name: Monasteries of St. Antonius & St. Paul from Hurghada – The Oldest Christian Monasteries in the World
before.short_description: Experience two of the oldest monasteries of Christianity on an exclusive private tour from Hurghada. The Monasteries of St. Antonius and St. Paul lie in seclusi...
before.description:
Experience two of the oldest monasteries of Christianity on an exclusive private tour from Hurghada. The Monasteries of St. Antonius and St. Paul lie in seclusion in the Eastern Desert and are among the most important spiritual sites of Egypt.

The Monasteries of St. Antonius and St. Paul are considered the oldest monasteries in the world. St. Antonius was founded in the 4th century, and St. Paul over the cave of Saint Paul, who is venerated as the first Christian hermit.

Both monasteries offer unique insights into early monasticism and the Coptic tradition of Egypt.

What makes this excursion so special:

Unlike the famous temples of Egypt, you experience the spiritual side of the country here. The secluded monasteries in the heart of the Eastern Desert offer a unique combination of history, religion, nature, and tranquility. Monks still live here today following centuries-old traditions.

Who is this excursion for?

This excursion is especially suitable for culturally interested travelers, Christians, history enthusiasts, and guests who want to discover the authentic Egypt away from the well-known tourist routes.
